scores.label: A
scores.note: options 1, 2, 3, 5 ('unattainable/unrealizable/unachievable/unobtainable to reach') are redundant and ungrammatical with the kept 'to reach'; option 4 'unreal' is the wrong meaning; options 6-10 duplicates

scores.label: B
scores.note: options 1-3 ('unattainable/unreachable/unrealizable to reach') are redundant and ungrammatical with the kept 'to reach'; option 4 'unattainable dreams' repeats 'dreams' and is ungrammatical in place

scores.label: C
scores.note: options 1-4 and 6-9 ('unreachable', 'out of reach', 'beyond reach', 'unattainable', 'out of grasp', 'beyond attainment', 'ungraspable', 'unreachable and fleeting') are redundant/ungrammatical before the kept 'to reach'; option 5 'elusive to reach' is awkward and softens 'impossible'; option 9 also adds 'fleeting'
